mapper.insert: insert into video_analysis_job(scenic_id, video_path, area_code, direction, sample_ms, status, created_by) values(#{scenicId}, #{videoPath}, #{areaCode}, #{direction}, #{sampleMs}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select * from video_analysis_job where id=#{id} limit 1
select * from video_analysis_job order by id desc
mapper.update: update video_analysis_job set status=#{status}, error_msg=#{errorMsg}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update video_analysis_job set status='RUNNING', error_msg=null, updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and status in ('PENDING','FAILED')
update video_analysis_job set status='RUNNING', error_msg=null, updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and (status in ('PENDING','FAILED') or (status='RUNNING' and updated_at < #{staleBefore}))
